definition: `ThoughtOccurs Occurs` is `∃ e, Occurs e` for a primitive, unconstrained predicate `Occurs` over a possibly empty carrier of thought episodes. An episode actually occurs only when `Occurs e` is independently supplied; mentioning or interpreting a token does not assert its occurrence. It does not itself assert a thinker, time, change, or the reliability of introspection.
note: Stipulated for the source-free Cogito schema (#523, #524; consolidated in #532). It uses the same occurrence primitive as the episode-occurrence definition of the performed-denial module `TruthCore.Logic.PerformedDenial` (#516), in the positive form; `ThoughtOccurs Occurs` implies, but is not constructively equivalent to, the negation of `NoEpisodeOccurs Occurs`. A sourced reading (for example Descartes, Meditationes II) would need a pinned witness.
